title: Stylish look, but useful for light duty ONLY ...
text:
Stylish look, but useful for light duty ONLY .... Very mixed feelings about these.

First, what'd good:
== size -- they're perfect for getting that last bit of mustard from a jar or stirring a bowl of creamy dip for a vegetable tray
== appearance -- very classy looking: gray silicone heads and stylish stainless-steel handles
== the silicone heads can be removed for cleaning

Now, the problems:
== the silicone heads do not fit tightly onto the stainless steel handles, so if you're trying to get that last bit of jam or preserves (or anything sticky), the head will slip right off
== the spoon head is very pliable, so it can't be used for any "heavy lifting" or scraping with anything more than very light force.

I'll definitely get more use out of the mini spatula rather than the spoon -- it's just too flimsy to be useful for anything but the lightest duty. Before I could give this set more than 3 stars, there would need to be some serious redesign so that the heads don't slip off so easily, and they can be strengthened to allow for more versatile use. I think they're OK -- but nothing I could really recommend at this time.
